svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: wears under rough care versus gentler care
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs. Rough care is drawn as 40 wears and gentler care as 80 wears. Not a laboratory result and not a Statistics Canada figure.
svg.text: Example wears before the garment is done
Example with made-up inputs. Not a wear test. Symbols were checked. These counts were not.
80 is twice 40. Bar length: 80 wears is 400 px. Your count is the one you observe.
Gentler here means the care symbol, less heat, and fewer cycles. Not a product claim.
Saving Optimizer, 29 Sep 2026. Care symbols checked. No wear study opened.
